correctness.rationale: For N=qm+r, the identity N=m(x+y+z)+y+3z splits representations by j=q−(x+y+z). For each t=r+jm, all feasible coin lengths are f(t),f(t)+2,... . The j=1 alternative is the first wrapped option because f(t+m)≥f(t); comparison with the second same-j=0 length gives the exact H_m(r) piecewise threshold. Monotonicity under adding m extends this to every q. Maximization and summation give exact p=1 Frobenius and genus, with m=4 explicitly treated. Exact-denumerant checker independently verifies all 11319 residues for m=4,...,150 and first threshold boundaries, plus F1 and gap counts.
